question: The Industrial (Development and Regulation) Act was first enacted in which year in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __1951.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Industrial (Development and Regulation) Act:

__
 
• It was enacted to regulate and control the development of industries in India.
 
• It was first enacted in 1951 in India.
 
• It was enacted to regulate and control the development of industries in India.
 
• The act aimed to prevent the concentration of economic power in a few hands and promote balanced regional development.
 
• It also provided for the establishment of the Industrial Development Bank of India (IDBI) to provide financial assistance to industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The following are the Act's objectives:

 
• To implement the** industrial policy.**
 
• **Regulation and Development** of Important Industries.
 
• **Planning and Future Development** of New Industries.
 
• Allowing the free play of** laissez-faire policy.**
